notes: GATE P4 PUBLIC-API REGRESSION. The normal Rust-first API drove the same real Tauri updater check and install used by consumers. Transition 1 selected Full from an empty cache, staged 1.0.1 as PENDING, and promoted it only after the 1.0.1 app launched. Transition 2 selected TarDelta from ACTIVE(1.0.1), requested the tar patch but neither the direct patch nor the full 1.0.2 artifact, reconstructed the exact signed target, and installed the exact expected 1.0.2 binary. A deliberately corrupted cache blob then degraded safely to Full and still installed the exact target. The three main binaries were asserted pairwise distinct. Both direct and tar patches self-round-tripped before publication. Ratios are controlled example-app measurements, not a general macOS claim. The companion onboarding rehearsal used a new clone of this commit: `cargo check --workspace --all-targets --locked` with warnings denied completed in 38.41 seconds and included the normal example. The documented path has five integration steps after prerequisites: add two dependencies, register two plugins, configure the existing updater endpoint/public key/artifact creation, call check/install, and run the release tool. The release CLI help reached the documented artifact/signing credential boundary. No undocumented local files or environment variables were required. The rehearsal found one stale Linux platform example in CLI help; it was corrected before this final clone and run.
artifact_provenance: `examples/desktop-app/e2e/build-three-versions.sh` built three real macOS application bundles with `cargo tauri build --features e2e-control` in a fresh per-run directory outside the repository, using only version-string changes and a generated per-run test signing key. The release tool built from this clean tree generated authenticated manifests plus direct and tar patches with `--require-tar-layer`. `examples/desktop-app/e2e/run-tar-e2e.sh` launched the bundled application, exercised the public updater API against an explicit loopback test server, and relaunched between transitions so cache promotion depended on the version that actually ran.
